cards.card_text: Meanwhile John the Baptist, who's been baptizing with water beyond the Jordan (John 1:26, 28), is out baptizing at Aenon near Salim.
cards.verse_text: Now John was also baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because the water was plentiful there, and people kept coming to be baptized.

cards.card_text: John's disciples tell him Jesus is baptizing now.
cards.verse_text: So John’s disciples came to him and said, “Look, Rabbi, the One who was with you beyond the Jordan, the One you testified about—He is baptizing, and everyone is going to Him.”
cards.snippet: …was with you beyond the Jordan, the One you testified about—He is baptizing, and everyone is going to Him.”

cards.card_text: Jesus is gaining and baptizing more disciples than John the Baptist, and the Pharisees, a group of strict religious leaders, are aware of it.
cards.verse_text: When Jesus realized that the Pharisees were aware He was gaining and baptizing more disciples than John
cards.snippet: When Jesus realized that the Pharisees were aware He was gaining and baptizing more disciples than John

cards.card_text: The place across the Jordan where Jesus stays is where ___ had first been baptizing.
cards.verse_text: Then Jesus went back across the Jordan to the place where John had first been baptizing, and He stayed there.
